name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Marketing Strategy & Sales Enablement | Pitch Materials That Close
summary: Marketing strategist and seller with 15+ years across agency, MarTech, and B2B SaaS, building the proposals, messaging, and pitch materials behind real revenue and then taking them into the room. Has written proposals and statements of work in every sales role since 2018, ranked top three in sales at Accelo while quota doubled, and closed ~$130K+ in new agency business at Fetch & Funnel. Writes across formats, from direct-response copy and landing pages to thought leadership and educational guides, and adapts one story for buyers, partners, and executives. Comfortable as the face of an organization in client conversations.

Write proposals and SOWs that turn discovery into a clear scope, cost, and value story, and expand accounts through new service proposals.
Write and publish thought leadership, newsletters, and educational guides for B2B audiences.
Write direct-response copy, landing pages, and outreach sequences that drive engagement and pipeline.
Pitch and close Solenzo clients directly as founder, from first conversation through signed engagement.
